We prove the assertion by weighted tilings. Let T_n be the set of tilings of a board of length n by monomers and dominoes. Separating tilings according to their final piece gives
W_{k+1}=W_k+a_kW_{k-1},
with W_0=W_1=1. Hence, by induction, W_n=u_n.

Now reflect every tiling of the length-n board. A domino originally beginning at i becomes a domino beginning at n-i. Under the weights used for v, its new weight is a_{n-i}, exactly the original weight. Reflection is a bijection, so the total reflected weight is unchanged. But the recurrence for these reflected tilings is
W'_{k+1}=W'_k+a_{n-k}W'_{k-1},
with W'_0=W'_1=1; hence W'_n=v_n. Therefore u_n=W_n=W'_n=v_n.
